about: The player's marks on enemy round 1 (https://claude.ai/artifact/Sm8d5jmPVxTwihiTiKdtGX), read back from its store on 2026-11-07. Notes are quoted exactly. Answer choices are 0-based indices into QUESTIONS in enemies.mjs; the chosen option's text is copied beside it. p-dive-bomber has a note but no verdict button set; its note opens "I like this", so the build reads it as go, with the player's redesign.

lure.name: Lure Beacon
lure.note: Yeah so passive attacks will hit this

p-dive-bomber.name: Dive Bomber
p-dive-bomber.note: I like this but it should not show the plane to last minute so this is a quick reaction attack. The player will see a circle where it is coming and then I will appear outta the sky as a dive bomber and the players has a small window to hit the plane before the bomb drops. Physical bomb can not be intercepted once it falls
